Red test: TestControllerStartWithNoGitHubAppRemovesAStaleHostsFile in packages/daemon/cmd/legion/controller_test.go, commit 06f586b74ecb; `cd packages/daemon && CGO_ENABLED=0 go test -count=1 ./cmd/legion/ -run TestControllerStartWithNoGitHubAppRemovesAStaleHostsFile` fails: `hosts.yml = "github.com:\n    oauth_token: ghs_stale_from_an_earlier_run…", <nil>; want none`.
